mod.name: Video: Timeline Preview
mod.author: AmoNova
mod.description: Native video carrier clips with a floating on-top mpv preview window that shows black when the playhead is on no video content. macOS (Apple silicon) / Bitwig 6.1.7; absolute-time clips keep their project-second position across tempo changes. Needs mpv: brew install mpv, or drop an mpv binary into the mod's player folder.
